newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: French plan chocolate trade fair in Ivory Coast.
newsitem.headline: French plan chocolate trade fair in Ivory Coast.

text.p: French chocolate confectioners plan to hold their 1998 Festival International du Chocolat trade fair in Ivory Coast and open up participation to more countries, the festival's president, Bernard Walger, said on Monday.
"We want to hold the next one in Abidjan," he said after arriving on Sunday and meeting Ivorian commodities minister Guy-Alain Gauze. "I hope it will be an international event."
Gauze was guest of honour at last year's event in Epinal, France and several chocolate products in the area now bear his name, said Walger.
French chocolate confectioners would continue supporting Ivorian opposition to a European proposal to allow use of non-cocoa fats in chocolate, he added.
Walger also supported Ivory Coast's goal of processing around 500,000 tonnes of its annual cocoa crop locally by 2000 to add value to its exports.
